snippet.title: Dice Card Heroes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and playtest now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930110/Dice_Card_Heroes/

In this roguelike deckbuilder, every card features its own dice. Battle against many fantastic creatures across 3 chapters. Upgrade your cards, build countless synergies and find mighty weapons to shape your playstyle. There is only one goal:
Be the hero, slay the dragon.
